title: MILO Marathon Vermosa Leg 2026 Review: RUNRIO's Cavite Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon Vermosa Leg 2026 Review | Cavite Philippines
meta_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 Vermosa Leg: October 11 in Vermosa, Cavite. 21K to 1K from RUNRIO — the Philippines' premier series heads to the Vermosa estate.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at the Vermosa estate in Imus/Dasmariñas, Cavite, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg offers five distances. Registration isn't confirmed yet.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Vermosa Leg brings RUNRIO's gold-standard production to Vermosa — a master-planned estate in Cavite that's become a running and cycling hub south of Manila. Five distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 3K, 1K) make it accessible across ages. Vermosa's wide, well-planned roads and its purpose-built sports facilities (including an athletics track) make it one of the better running venues in the Cavite-Laguna corridor. Registration isn't confirmed yet, but for a MILO qualifier, RUNRIO's template is proven.

sections.heading: Vermosa: Cavite's Sports Hub
paragraphs: Vermosa is a master-planned estate in the Imus-Dasmariñas corridor with wide roads, an athletics track, and a growing reputation as a running and cycling destination. faqs.question: When is the MILO Marathon Vermosa Leg 2026?
faqs.answer: 11 October 2026 at Vermosa, Cavite, Philippines. It offers 1K, 3K, 5K, 10K, and 21.1K. Registration is listed as not yet confirmed open. RUNRIO Inc. (MILO Marathon) organises the event. It's held at Vermosa, Imus/Dasmariñas, Cavite. [1]
